observed.name: omniview-ui-implementation
observed.description: Preserve Omniview UI/UX when building, fixing, migrating, or reviewing host/plugin views, forms, tables, charts, controls, CSS, themes, and component-library integrations. Use for every UI-affecting change, even an import-only library migration or data-layer cutover with visible consumers. Detect approved-composition drift, missing information, unsuitable density, native-control loopholes, and shared-library gaps before declaring completion.
